questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are prohibited on this road

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrians are prohibited on this road
questions.explanation: This sign means pedestrians are not allowed on this roadway, typically on freeways or expressways where walking would be extremely dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No parking allowed in this area
No standing or stopping at any time
Tow-away zone — violators will be towed

questions.correctAnswerText: No parking allowed in this area
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that parking is prohibited in the posted area. Vehicles may not park here at any time, though brief stops to load or unload passengers may be allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No through traffic to the left

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns at this intersection or location. Drivers must go straight or turn right instead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left turn only at the next intersection
No right turn or U-turn allowed
No left turn and no U-turn allowed

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn and no U-turn allowed
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits both left turns and U-turns at this location. Drivers must continue straight or turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and wait for signal to proceed

questions.explanation: This sign means you must not enter the road or ramp where this sign is posted. It is usually displayed at the exit ramp of a freeway or on one-way streets to prevent wrong-way travel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield — slow down and give the right of way

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield — slow down and give the right of way
questions.explanation: The yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop to let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass before you proceed. You must stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Straight ahead only — no turns allowed
Through traffic has the right of way
Road narrows ahead — stay in lane

questions.correctAnswerText: Straight ahead only — no turns allowed
questions.explanation: This sign means you must continue straight ahead. Left turns and right turns are not permitted at this intersection from this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Go straight or turn left only — no right turn
Left turn only from this lane
Right lane must turn right ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Go straight or turn left only — no right turn
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that from this lane you may only go straight or turn left. Right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Minimum speed required on this road
Maximum speed limit — do not exceed the posted speed

questions.correctAnswerText: Maximum speed limit — do not exceed the posted speed
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum legal speed you may travel on the road under ideal conditions. Driving faster than the posted limit is illegal and unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: One-way street — traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow
Merge into a single lane ahead
Right turn only from this lane

questions.correctAnswerText: One-way street — traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a one-way street where all traffic must travel in the direction shown by the arrow. Do not enter against the flow of traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane control — use designated lanes for turning or going straight

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane control — use designated lanes for turning or going straight
questions.explanation: This sign shows which lanes are designated for turning and which are for going straight. You must follow the direction indicated for the lane you are in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left lane ends ahead — merge right
Left turn only — you must turn left from this lane
Left turn permitted on green arrow only

questions.correctAnswerText: Left turn only — you must turn left from this lane
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the lane is designated for left turns only. Vehicles in this lane must make a left turn and cannot go straight or turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Four-way intersection ahead — all directions must stop

questions.correctAnswerText: Four-way intersection ahead — all directions must stop
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a four-way stop where traffic from all four directions must come to a complete stop. The first vehicle to stop has the right of way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign indicates that the normal route is closed and drivers must follow the designated detour. Follow the detour signs until you return to the original route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn at this intersection
No turning allowed on red light

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits making a U-turn at this location. Drivers must find an alternative route to reverse direction.
